source.description: Public deterministic GeoLibre 0.2 project containing camera, basemap, embedded GeoJSON, XYZ, WMS, PMTiles, reusable processing models and history, preserved unsupported analysis, style, group, legend, multi-map, comment, and metadata records.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: The pinned GeoLibre project imports offline, exports as format 0.2.0, and retains a field-level preservation report.
Embedded GeoJSON and governed XYZ, WMS, and PMTiles candidates map without dereferencing external URLs.
Layer presentation and the supported style and label subset survive an OpenGeo-to-GeoLibre round trip.
Known processing tools and reusable models map explicitly, while every unsupported operation remains preserved with an operation-level loss result and never executes during import.
